source: Kubernetes Prow public job history and kubernetes-ci-logs

scope.job_selection: 104 job names that were multi-repository presubmits in the current Prow window

decision: Do not use generic Prow presubmit history as the main source for the flagship causal track. Keep Prow as a targeted rolling lead source, and require code-tree identity plus failure-to-target semantic alignment before admission.
limitations: The scan starts from job names visible as multi-repository presubmits on 2026-08-23, so retired or renamed jobs are outside the frame.
The public directory covered roughly the preceding 90 days; this is not an all-time Prow census.
A successful recovery after a target branch advance remains only a structural lead until the target delta explains the failure signature.
